collection.scope: all accessible refs; Azure DevOps (private, aggregated) + GitHub owned repositories
collection.dedup: by commit SHA across refs, repositories and platforms
collection.identity: owner-authored (author e-mail is one of the owner's addresses)

definitions.git.owner_authored_shas: Unique commit SHAs whose Git author is one of the owner's verified identities, in every accessible ref of every source (default and other branches, PR iterations, deleted branches recovered by id), counted once. Repository activity, not manually written lines or individual productivity.
definitions.git.owner_committed_shas: Unique SHAs whose Git committer is one of the owner's identities (includes squash commits created by Azure DevOps on completion).
definitions.git.default_branch_shas: Owner-authored SHAs reachable from a default branch.
definitions.git.other_live_branch_only_shas: Owner-authored SHAs only on live non-default branches.
definitions.git.deleted_branch_recovered_shas: Owner-authored SHAs no longer on any branch, recovered by id from Azure DevOps.
definitions.git.pr_shas: Owner-authored SHAs that belong to an Azure DevOps pull request.
definitions.git.merge_commit_shas: Owner-authored SHAs with two or more parents.
definitions.git.unrecoverable_shas: SHAs referenced by Azure DevOps whose objects could not be retrieved.
definitions.sources.github_only: Owner-authored SHAs found only on GitHub (owned repositories).
definitions.sources.azure_devops_only: Owner-authored SHAs found only in Azure DevOps (not present in the private GitHub mirror).
definitions.sources.both: Owner-authored SHAs present on both platforms (same SHA).
definitions.delivery.prs_created: Pull requests opened by the owner (Azure DevOps + GitHub).
definitions.delivery.prs_abandoned: Of those, abandoned / closed without merge.
definitions.delivery.prs_reviewed: Pull requests by others that the owner reviewed (vote or review).
definitions.delivery.squash_merges: Completed Azure DevOps PRs merged with the squash strategy.
definitions.delivery.median_hours_to_merge: Median hours from PR creation to completion (owner PRs).
definitions.contributions.official_total: Contributions shown by the official GitHub calendar for the period (all types).
definitions.contributions.eligible_mirrored_commits: Default-branch commits in the private mirrors authored with an e-mail verified on the GitHub account.
definitions.contributions.calendar_upper_bound: Sum over days of min(calendar count, eligible mirrored commits that day): the most eligible commits the calendar can be showing (an upper bound, not proof of recognition).
definitions.contributions.pending_on_calendar: eligible_mirrored_commits minus calendar_upper_bound: eligible commits the calendar provably does not show yet.
